title: Bombay Vegetable Sandwich
description: A Mumbai street sandwich of green chutney, boiled potato, beetroot, cucumber, tomato and onion layered between buttered bread.
steps: Butter one side of all 6 slices of bread and spread the coriander chutney over 3 of them.
Arrange the potato, beetroot, cucumber, tomato and onion in layers on the chutney slices.
Sprinkle the chaat masala and salt evenly over the vegetables.
Close with the remaining slices, buttered side down, and press gently.
Toast on a hot tawa or sandwich griller until golden, or serve untoasted.
Cut into triangles and serve with ketchup.
